description: Initialization script for Kubernetes, setting environment variables, sourcing utility scripts, defining functions for path resolution, and checking if already loaded.

methods.name: kube::readlinkdashf
methods.description: Emulates 'readlink -f' on systems where it's unavailable, resolving symlinks and absolute paths.

methods.name: kube::realpath
methods.description: Resolves the absolute path of a file or directory, emulating 'realpath' on systems where it's unavailable.

methods.name: kube::init::loaded
methods.description: Marker function indicating the init.sh script has been fully sourced.
